label: SW base named fights High|Medium
brief: Two named wild-creature fights in the Stormwood storm forest (capacitor alpha, glass-field alpha) through the production camera: before, one-second interval frames (iNN), telegraphed attacks (tell start, strike, impact) and after. Does the fight read on screen - both fighters (the large wild creature and the player's smaller creature) and the telegraphs and impacts clearly visible, without trunks, canopy or foliage blocking or washing out the view - and does it look like an event that belongs to the storm forest?
defects: Flat magenta slabs or rings on the ground
Clipping (geometry passing through geometry, or the camera inside geometry)
P2-063: tells rely on text while flat magenta floor marks and bright impact flashes carry the hits
P2-016: hurt and moving frames keep the idle silhouette
P2-004: the many dark boxed HUD panels occupy a large share of the view
